name: Voxel Refraction & Total Internal Reflection Handling
definition: Modifies the ray direction upon entering a refractive voxel using Snell's law, with a fallback to the original direction if total internal reflection occurs to prevent infinite ray bouncing and performance degradation.
summary: Voxel Refraction modifies ray direction via Snell's law in sparse voxel grids, distinguished by its fallback to the original direction upon total internal reflection to prevent infinite bouncing.
